title: Simple modus hides max-IOB
body:
When going through objectives you have to increase max-IOB. After building and installing latest version you however get the interface on simple modus so the max-IOB option is hidden. Took me a while to find it. 

It's written in the docs over [here](https://androidaps.readthedocs.io/en/latest/SettingUpAaps/CompletingTheObjectives.html#objective-7-tuning-the-closed-loop-raising-maxiob-above-0-and-gradually-lowering-bg-targets:~:text=If%20you%20are%20still%20in%20Simple%20Mode%20at%20this%20point%2C%20now%20is%20probably%20a%20good%20time%20to%20switch%20it%20off.) that simple mode should be turned off, but it should also be possible to only rely on the app I think.
